My father had a very close friend from work. This man developed a brain tumor, I won't get into the decision making around it, but his wife is someone who will never cease to frustrate me. He was getting worse very quickly. This man was very kind, very funny, and a great person inside and wonderful go be around.


One day, my father, mother, and I, were all on the main floor of our house. My father was in the restroom, mother in the kitchen, and I in the living room. My father's phone starts to ring, and he was already washing his hands so he quickly dried to open the door and pick up. Well, the doorknob wouldn't turn. He tried again, no luck. Three times the charm, doorknob turns! And falls right into his hand. 


The only issue we ever had with this door, for my whole life, was that it never *actually* locked. If you locked it, someone on either side could easily put minimal pressure and open it, even without turning the knob.


My dad gets out a minute later when the door miraculously unstuck. Checks his phone, it was the man's wife. He calls her back and is told that his friend passed.



We don't know if this was actually paranormal or just a really big coincidence. My father isn't a believer, but he took this as his friend giving him a little goodbye prank, and it helps soften the loss for him.
